purpose: Machine-readable evidence contract for Phase 5 #t56 runtime alert routing, Alertmanager handoff, and target-environment drill review.

required_configuration: deploy/monitoring/phase5-runtime-alerts.yaml is loaded by the target Prometheus or equivalent rule manager
janusgate_http_requests_total is scraped from the target JanusGate backend
janusgate_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket is scraped from the target JanusGate backend
required_records: promtool check rules or equivalent validation command
rule file revision or Git SHA
scrape target label used for JanusGate
secret_handling: Do not record Prometheus credentials, bearer tokens, receiver token values, or datasource passwords.
Do not archive raw metrics that include customer-specific labels beyond the approved service, namespace, route, method, and status labels.

required_configuration: Alertmanager or equivalent notification router is configured for JanusGate runtime alerts
JanusGateRuntimeHigh5xxRate routes to the production incident receiver
JanusGateRuntimeHighP95Latency routes to the production incident receiver
JanusGateRuntimeMetricsEndpointMissing routes to the production incident receiver
required_records: test alert or synthetic drill timestamp
secret_handling: Record whether a receiver token is configured, but never record the receiver token value.
Do not store Alertmanager webhook payload bodies when they include customer, token, or integration-secret data.
Do not commit PagerDuty, Slack, email relay, webhook, or on-call platform secrets to Git.
